    def predict_score(self, features, items):
        # DEBUG: expose the SASRec compatibility scorer on the actual module.
        # These are encoder-only logits; graph scoring requires explicit user
        # context and remains in forward/predict rather than this interface.
        if features.ndim not in (2, 3):
            raise ValueError("Expected B x H or B x L x H features")
        items = torch.as_tensor(items, device=features.device, dtype=torch.long)
        if items.ndim != features.ndim or items.shape[:-1] != features.shape[:-1]:
            raise ValueError("Candidate leading dimensions must match features")
        if features.shape[-1] != self.hidden_units:
            raise ValueError("Feature dimension differs from hidden_units")
        if items.shape[-1] == 0:
            return features.new_empty(items.shape)
        embeddings = self.item_emb(items)
        return torch.matmul(embeddings, features.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)

    def _candidate_dots(self, features, candidates):
        # DEBUG: share encoder scoring between training, inference, and probes.
        return self.predict_score(features, candidates)
